description.narrative:
Ecoaction has prepared the first position on expanding the concept of just transition beyond coal-mining regions to include other carbon-intensive mono-industrial communities. The position highlighted the need to integrate these communities into national planning documents, ensuring that potential social risks from the transition away from fossil fuels are properly addressed.
It was shared with the Ministry of Economy, Environment and Agriculture of Ukraine and its Green Transition Office to inform policy discussions. Additionally, the position was disseminated to international partners, including CAN International, CAN Europe, Beyond Fossil Fuels Coalition, CEE Bankwatch Network and Build Ukraine Back Better Coalition, as well as to climate-focused civil society organisations in Ukraine – the Ukrainian Climate Network which unites more than 30 NGOs. It was also adopted into a column which was published in the Ukrainian media, specifically Ekonomichna Pravda.

The activity provides achieving the next output: At least one position of Ecoaction and at least one joint position with other NGOs/coalition(s) of NGOs on the issues with the current definition and understanding of just transition are prepared and raised with the Ministry of Economy, the Ministry of Communities and Territories Development and the Ministry of Environmental Protection and Natural Resources, and in the Ukrainian media.

activity-date.narrative: Recommendations, comments and new materials have been gathered to update posted in position with relevant information
The main activity (publication) was conducted in September 2025

sector.narrative: Position is aimed at Ukranian climate&energy NGOs and governmental structures as Ministry of Economy, Ministry of Communities and Territories Development, Ministry of Environmental Protection and Natural Resources, Ministry of Energy and the Office of Green Transition under the Ministry of Economy.
